title: Gate the MERGE state locally, so a local green is the object CI gates
description:
Filed from the THIRD recurrence of one trap in a single session (LCLI-669's docs gate, LCLI-670 review round 1, then LCLI-670's docs gate again).

A local `lore check` on a branch reads a DIFFERENT OBJECT from the one CI gates: CI runs on the PR's MERGE with the base branch, so a docs edit that only tips a profile over its declared capacity ONCE dev's own docs land reads green locally and red on CI. It has cost three full push-and-wait cycles, and each time the remedy was a judgement ("merge dev before gating") that had to be REMEMBERED — the weakest kind of fix, and one the operator's rule says to replace with a check.

Remove the judgement:
  (a) `scripts/gate-merged.sh`: create a throwaway worktree at the pushed head, merge `origin/dev` into it there, run `lore check` in THAT tree, and exit with its code — so the local green is the same object CI gates. (Optionally the same for `bun test`.)
  (b) a pre-push guard doing the same against the branch being pushed.

Either shape is acceptable; pick the smaller. INTERIM until LCLI-722's profile reshape lands, because the underlying pressure is the four profiles' declared sets sitting near their budgets, and the reshape is what removes it rather than working around it.

HELD, tracker-only filing, no code. Do not start before #581 (LCLI-670) and LCLI-723.
